## User story
As a [type of user],
I want [a specific capability],
so that [the benefit or value].

## Context
Describe the problem and why this story matters.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Given [starting situation], when [action], then [expected result].
- [ ] Given [another situation], when [action], then [expected result].

## Scope
Included:
- Describe what this story covers.

Excluded:
- Describe what will be handled separately.

## Tasks
- [ ] Implement the feature.
- [ ] Verify each acceptance criterion.
- [ ] Open a pull request linked to this issue.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass.
- [ ] Changes are reviewed and merged.
